c-anon-sitemap.2.evidence: spaces-1 holds 35 <url> and posts-1 232, each with loc, lastmod, changefreq (weekly), priority (0.5); five sampled post locs return 200; both documents parse as valid XML.

c-anon-sitemap.3.evidence: No Customer Advisory Board, Moderators' Room, Insiders, Partner Program or Release Planning URL in either sitemap (grep count 0).

c-anon-sitemap.5.evidence: Seeded 12,000 QA-RFT public topics (removed afterwards): posts sitemap splits into 3 pages (5000, 5000, 2241 URLs), page 4 is 404, union has 0 duplicate locs.

c-anon-sitemap.6.evidence: With 12,000+ topics /community-sitemap.xml answers 200 in 0.049s (post pages 0.11-0.15s uncached).

c-anon-sitemap.7.evidence: The archived 2025 Hackathon space is not listed (0 matches in the spaces sitemap), i.e. archived spaces are excluded; the spaces sitemap has 35 of 41 spaces (3 private, 2 hidden, 1 archived left out). lastmod values are ISO activity dates.

c-anon-sitemap.8.evidence: Deleted one public topic + Sitemap_Emitter::flush() -> its URL disappears from all posts sitemap pages.

c-anon-sitemap.9.evidence: seo_sitemap=0 -> /community-sitemap.xml 404 and robots.txt loses the community-sitemap Sitemap line; restored to default, 200 and line back.

c-anon-sitemap.11.evidence: Needs Yoast SEO (third-party plugin) installed; not on this stack.

c-anon-sitemap.12.evidence: Three sitemap-listed URLs (announcements space, knowledge-base space, welcome topic) return 200 with no horizontal overflow at 1440 and 390.

c-anon-sitemap.13.evidence: Response header X-Robots-Tag: noindex, follow is present on /community-sitemap.xml.
